New Frame parts is only for R4 production console with New Frame.
Followings are the differences between Original Frame Console and New Frame Console.

Shape of the anterior part of Elevation Arm.

8-43-3 Replacement of BACKBONE FRONT TOP LCF
1.) Remove the BACKBONE REAR COVER LCF.
2.) Set the ELEVATION ARM ASSY in horizontal position.

8-43-4 Replacement of BACKBONE FRONT BOTTOM LCF

1.) Remove the BACKBONE REAR COVER LCF.
2.) Remove the BACKBONE FRONT TOP LCF.
CABINET ASSY R4 shapes differ for each configuration but removal/installation procedure are the same.
Slide out the LOW CABINET or MID CABINET ASSY R4 toward front of the console. No tools required.
Slide out the LOW CABINET or MID CABINET ASSY R4 toward front of the console. No tools required.

Unscrew 3 screws to remove the SIDE COVER R POLARIS ASSY.
Unscrew 4 screws to remove the MID FRAME POLARIS.
Direction 5394227, 13 LOGIQ S8/E8/S7 XDclear2.0 Service Manual
Unscrew 6 screws and then pull out the BACKBONE FRONT BOTTOM LCF.
Direction 5394227, 13 LOGIQ S8/E8/S7 XDclear2.0 Service Manual
8-43-4-2 BACKBONE FRONT BOTTOM LCF on High Cabinet Console
1.) Remove the BACKBONE REAR COVER LCF.
2.) Remove the BACKBONE FRONT TOP LCF.
4.) Remove the SIDE COVER L ASSY.
5.) Remove the SIDE COVER R ASSY.
Direction 5394227, 13 LOGIQ S8/E8/S7 XDclear2.0 Service Manual
Unscrew 5 screws to remove the SPEAKER DUMMY BACK BRKT.
Unscrew 6 screws to remove the SPEAKER.
Remove the HIGH FRAME GROUND BRKT.
Unscrew 6 screws and then pull out the BACKBONE FRONT BOTTOM LCF.
Direction 5394227, 13 LOGIQ S8/E8/S7 XDclear2.0 Service Manual
8-43-5 Replacement of ELEVATION UPPER COVER LCF
1.) Set the ELEVATION ARM ASSY in horizontal position.
Unhook the ELEVATION UPPER COVER LCF to disassemble from the ELEVATION ARM ASSY. There are 2 hooks on each side of the ELEVATION UPPER COVER LCF.
Lift the ELEVATION UPPER COVER LCF and remove it diagonally.
Direction 5394227, 13 LOGIQ S8/E8/S7 XDclear2.0 Service Manual
8-43-6 Replacement of ELEVATION LOWER COVER LCF
NOTE: "Short" type driver preferable for ELEVATION LOWER COVER LCF removal/installation.

8-43-7 Replacement of ELEVATION ARM ASSY. LCF
Phillips screwdriver, Allen Wrench, 2 adjustable wrench (For NUT M4 and M6)
1.) Remove Monitor and LCD Arm Plastic covers.
Direction 5394227, 13 LOGIQ S8/E8/S7 XDclear2.0 Service Manual
Unscrew 4 screws to disassemble the ELEVATION LOWER COVER LCF.
Unscrew 2 Hexagonal socket screws to remove 2 Cable clamps.
Remove the cable tie if it is attached as graphic right.
Pull out the Monitor cables and OP Panel cable through the hole.
Direction 5394227, 13 LOGIQ S8/E8/S7 XDclear2.0 Service Manual
Gently push and pull the cables through the hole under the ELEVATION ARM LOWER FRAME.
Pull out the cable through the hole.
Unscrew 1 screw to remove GROUND CABLE.
Direction 5394227, 13 LOGIQ S8/E8/S7 XDclear2.0 Service Manual
Direction 5394227, 13 LOGIQ S8/E8/S7 XDclear2.0 Service Manual
Unscrew 6 Hexagonal socket screws to disassemble OPIO Base from the Elevation arm assy.
For the system with High cabinet
Remove ELEVATION ARM UPPER COVER LCF and also remove the stopper of both side as right figure.
Hold ELEVATION ARM ASSY with one hand and unscrew 6 screws to disassemble ELEVATION ARM ASSY from Frame by using 6mm Allen Wrench.
Direction 5394227, 13 LOGIQ S8/E8/S7 XDclear2.0 Service Manual
CAUTION DO NOT pull the wire casually while at work. The elevation arm moves unexpectedly. Doing so may cause injury.
Replace the stopper with which remove from the elevation arm cover in Step 14 of Section 2-6-4.
Remove the stopper from both side from the exchanged Elevation arm.

NOTE: Use torque 60 kgfcm for M5 screws to fasten OPIO Base to Elevation arm.
NOTE: Use torque 150 kgfcm for M8 screws to fasten Handle to Backbone
